bio: Giovanni Francesco Cicco, also recorded as Joannes, was born on 5 January 1688 at San Mango di Aquino in Catanzaro, Calabria, the son of Antonino Cicco and Anna Maletta. On 10 September 1713 he married Francesca Sposata. He is John's 9th-great-grandfather.
